story.title: Story 2: Chunk Assembly From Turn Projections

result.reviewScopeSummary: Verified Story 2 against the story spec, full Epic 5 tech design, and test plan; then traced chunk assembly, projection-count authority, transcript persistence, legacy blocking, and lower-band selection/materialization surfaces in production code and tests. Evidence shows chunk boundaries now consume persisted conversation-only projection counts, chunks persist a separate conversation-only transcript while retaining smooth text, closed membership stays stable, and smart-compact/runtime selection blocks legacy placeholder-era chunks.
additionalObservations: Targeted story-focused verification passed across chunk service, async-thread readiness, thread-view builder, PI-thread builder, and foundation suites.
`npm run verify` passed with the full non-E2E gate, and `npm run verify-all` also passed with E2E/runtime coverage.

Legacy placeholder-generation code still exists elsewhere in the repo for later Epic 5 work, but the reviewed runtime selection/build paths block legacy chunks with `legacy_placeholder_chunk_state` rather than selecting them as lower-band output.
Story 2 evidence for TC-2.4/TC-2.5 is contract/state based, which matches the story scope; model-backed semantic detailed/brief generation remains later-story work.
